title: Impact on Employment of Full-time and Part-time Drivers from Expansion of Coverage of Progressive Wage Model
what_it_is: Impact on Employment of Full-time and Part-time Drivers from Expansion of Coverage of Progressive Wage Model

sections.label: Misclassification of employees
sections.summary: MOM will investigate employers who terminate contracts but still engage workers as employees, and take action where warranted.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Speaker, if an employer terminates an employee’s contract of service, but still engages the worker’s services under conditions that effectively makes the worker an employee, this is misclassification of an employee to avoid employer obligations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Manpower (MOM) will investigate such cases and take action against employers where warranted.

sections.label: Progressive Wage Credit Scheme
sections.summary: The PWCS funds up to 75% of 2023 wage increases for employees earning up to $2,500 and 45% for those earning above $2,500 up to $3,000.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: To help employers with the expansion of the Progressive Wage Model, the Government has introduced the Progressive Wage Credit Scheme (PWCS) as transitional support.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The PWCS funds up to 75% of the wage increases given in 2023 to employees earning up to $2,500 and 45% for those earning above $2,500 up to $3,000.

sections.label: Unfair termination complaints channels
sections.summary: Unfairly terminated workers can approach MOM, the Tripartite Alliance or unions, and no complaints have been received about termination and conversion to self-employment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: If something is amiss, where you are terminated unfairly, you can always come to MOM, the Tripartite Alliance for Fair and Progressive Employment Practices or one of the unions, especially for those in the Progressive Wage Model sectors, where most are pretty much covered by the unions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: As far as we know, today, neither MOM nor any of our lead sector agencies have received any complaints with regard to termination and being converted to be self-employed persons.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: I think in a tight labour market, as I have explained, one who is unfairly terminated and being asked to come back as a platform worker, for example, I think that is unfair.

sections.label: Self-employed serving multiple employers
sections.summary: Once you are self-employed, you can serve multiple employers too.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Once you are self-employed, you can serve multiple employers too.
